finaler_termin.label: Finaler Termin
finaler_termin.description:
A reference to a LivingApp record from the target lookup app 'Terminvorschläge' with the id `6af6e7378effe68c72d780b5` (or `null`/`None`).

The field value will be a valid record URL in the form `https://my.living-apps.de/rest/v1/apps/6af6e7378effe68c72d780b5/records/<record-id>` (or `null`/`None`).

When writing, either pass a record URL through exactly as this API returned it, or send the portable relative form `/apps/6af6e7378effe68c72d780b5/records/<record-id>`. Other equivalent record-URL forms are accepted as well.

Displayed as single-select field in HTML pages.

beginn.label: Beginn
beginn.description:
A specific moment in time consisting of year, month, day, hour and minute (or `null`/`None`)

The field value will be a string in the format `<YYYY>-<MM>-<DD>T<HH>:<MM>` (or `null`/`None`).

For example: `2000-02-29T11:30`.

For `POST`/`PUT`/`PATCH` requests the REST API uses a liberal parsing approach so that strings like `2026`, `February 29, 2000 12:34 MEST`, `letztes Jahr` etc. will be accepted as value datetime values. However this runs the risk of parsing ambiguous values incorrectly. To ensure reliable parsing it is best to use the canonical format specified above.
